paper: FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers
replicated_targets: AppendixB.1/Theorem7: pullback metric recursion across component boundaries
adaptation: Unchanged Qwen3.5-0.8B, one complete native full-attention block, four fresh questions and directional/matrix-free derivatives. The original concept-steering benchmarks and reported model scores were not reproduced.
distinctions: Metric transport follows the chain rule; finite endpoint KL is the independent prediction test.
The four-direction covariance is not a full hidden-space Fisher spectrum.
No stored physical energy, global equilibrium, semantic direction or unknown-steering detector is established.
The signed-cost Taylor explanation uses standard log-partition/Bregman calculus; no novelty claim.
